purpose: correct only the interpretation of BKPM DataTables count fields after the preregistered search probe showed that recordsTotal is rewritten to the post-search count, while preserving the original probe and all value-blind boundaries

observed_transport_semantics.positive_search: recordsTotal equals recordsFiltered after search rather than preserving the unfiltered baseline total
observed_transport_semantics.negative_control: both recordsTotal and recordsFiltered become zero

why_this_is_representation_only: the amendment changes no source, pilot, geography target, row selection, period identity, schema, investment value, or scientific estimand; it only interprets endpoint count-field behavior demonstrated by the preregistered positive and negative transport controls
amended_transport_qualification_rule: for each locked pilot: positive search must return HTTP 200 JSON with data=[], positive post-search count > 0 and < the separately frozen unfiltered baseline count, positive recordsTotal == recordsFiltered; negative control must return HTTP 200 JSON with data=[] and recordsTotal == recordsFiltered == 0
